revised_email.role: Clarify the Lifetime Guarantee coverage boundary
revised_email.subject: Where lifetime coverage stops
revised_email.preview_text: Consumables have an as-is guarantee; other tools and parts are covered.
revised_email.headline: Know what the Lifetime Guarantee covers
revised_email.body:
“Lifetime Guarantee” needs one clear boundary: it does not mean lifetime replacement for every item in the kit.

The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit is an organized electronics-repair kit combining a 64-bit driver assortment with opening, prying, gripping, and anti-static tools. Its product page identifies a Lifetime Guarantee.

Consumable products in the toolkit carry their own “as-is” guarantee and do not receive lifetime-guarantee replacement. Documented consumables include opening tools, opening picks, spudgers, and the small cap supplied with the Angled ESD Tweezers.

iFixit states that the kit’s other tools and parts are covered. That makes the guarantee meaningful without making it blanket coverage.

The product page shows the included tools and the Lifetime Guarantee designation. Review both to decide whether the coverage boundary meets your expectations for a first general repair toolkit.

revised_critique.summary: The email clearly identifies the toolkit, accurately states the documented consumables boundary without implying its list is exhaustive, and gives the reader a supported reason to inspect the product page.
